detail.title: Bungee 212 Mouse Cable Management Device with Rainbow LED - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports Bungee 212 is a mouse cable bungee designed to lift and manage a mouse cord, reducing drag and friction against the desk for smoother, more precise mouse movement during gaming or everyday use. Its spring arm holds the cable at an adjustable height, floating it just above the desk surface so it never catches or snags mid-swipe, and rainbow LED lighting adds a vibrant accent to any desk setup. A stable, weighted base keeps it firmly anchored during fast gaming movements, making the Bungee 212 a simple, effective upgrade for anyone who wants smoother mouse glide without switching to a wireless setup.
